savings.reason: ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11948 section 3 revokes EO:11868 as amended without savings or transfer. ORIGINAL:EO:11868 sections 5-8 authorize only Commission-related advisory committees, support, funding, compensation, expenses and FACA administration; none creates an independent future program after Commission revocation. Neither ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11873 nor ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11936 preserves such an independent command. The bounded OFR and cutoff eCFR searches disclose no revival or residual command. No specific continuing accrued liability is established; ending prospective authority does not itself adjudicate reimbursement already accrued.

conflict_resolutions.STATED_EFFECTIVE_DATE_DIFFERS: ACT:EO:11868>EO:11948 and complete ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11948 section 3 expressly set 1977-01-16 for revocation of EO:11868 as amended. This specific date governs instead of actor signing 1976-12-20 or the general section 5 effective date 1976-12-31.

research_rationale: ORIGINAL:EO:11868, all three full actor contexts, original report-deadline leads, and the complete earlier chain were read. ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11873 replaces original section 2 immediately on 1975-07-21; ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11936 replaces original section 4(c) immediately on 1976-09-08. Their hereby-amended directions have no deferred effective language. These original clauses therefore end earlier than the remaining original provisions; their replacement arrangements are subsequently revoked with the order as amended. The original report intervals and replacement 1977-01-15 report deadline do not automatically terminate authority, and no actual report performance is asserted. ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11948 section 3 expressly fixes 1977-01-16 for this revocation, controlling over its general 1976-12-31 effective date and 1976-12-20 signature. The whole-order end is the latest clause first end, 1977-01-16. The complete original contains no separate self-expiry or independent retained command. The adequate bounded OFR catalog and saved-order-text search covers all known amendments and revocation; cutoff eCFR search adds no live predicate. The U.S. Code search has an express five-day cutoff gap and is not selected as cutoff proof. These searches support a rebuttable no-earlier-cessation conclusion without inventing unreported actual performance.
